alkylation_concentration.evidence: In brief, the collected extracellular vesicles were reduced with 10 mM dithiothreitol (30 min at room temperature), alkylated with 20 mM iodoacetamide (30 min at RT in the dark). Subsequently, the protein mixtures were incubated with Lys-C (enzyme/protein, 1:100, w/w) for 4 h and trypsin (enzyme/protein, 1:50, w/w) for 12 h at 37 °C. The resulting peptide mixtures were quenched with 10% trifluoroacetic acid to a final concentration of 1% and cleaned with home-made C18 StageTips.
